title: Duties and Needs in Audit Reports

sections.title: What you know: the -andó/-endő participle
sections.content: You know the participle in *-andó/-endő* from B1 Unit 14 and the official register from C1 Unit 8. Audit reports use it for a duty: `Ez a kérdés még tisztázandó.` (This question is still to be clarified.)

sections.title: What this lesson adds
sections.content: *X-ra szorul* (needs X): `A jelentés megfontolásra szorul.` (The report needs consideration.) The verb takes *-ra/-re*, like the verbs you know from B1 Unit 2. The new words are *számvevőszék*, *alapvető jogok biztosa*, *közérdekű adat*, *visszaélés*, *orvoslás*.
